kaikki_vikisozluk.e: رَابَ • (rāba) I (non-past يَرُوبُ (yarūbu), verbal noun رَوْب (rawb) or رُءُوب (ruʔūb))
رُوبِيَان or رُوبْيَان • (rūbiyān or rūbyān) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: A modernly preferred form for إِرْبِيَان (ʔirbiyān) accepted as the conventional shape in Classical Arabic, which has been inherited from Proto-Semitic *ʾirbay- (“locust”), together with Eblaite 𒅕𒉈𒈝 (ir-bí-núm /⁠ʾerbênum⁠/) also giving evidence of an original *-ān component not found in other Semitic attestations.

g: ellipsis of لَبَن رَائِب (laban rāʔib, “sour milk”)

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: مُرِيب • (murīb) (feminine مُرِيبَة (murība), masculine plural مُرِيبُون (murībūn), feminine plural مُرِيبَات (murībāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Derived from the active participle of the verb أَرَابَ (ʔarāba).
g: suspicious (raising suspicion), dubious (causing doubt), questionable, fishy, shady
